Figure 4:Illustration of the Debias-SparseGPT reconstruction algorithm for the weight matrix𝐖\mathbf{W}.
Given paired inputs(𝐗0,𝐗1)(\mathbf{X}_{0},\mathbf{X}_{1}), a bias-aware Hessian is accumulated over the input texts as defined in Eq. (4).
Next, a binary pruning mask𝐌\mathbf{M}is constructed under a target sparsity from the second-order saliency scoresεp\varepsilon_{p}(Eq. (5)).
Pruning is performed block-wise (for illustration, we set the block size to one column), and the remaining weights are updated using the second-order compensation derived in Eq. (3).
